test_load_external: test that py::module_local types registered in an external module can be loaded across modules
test_local_bindings: test that duplicate py::module_local class bindings work correctly across multiple pybind11 modules
test_nonlocal_failure: test that registering a non-local type in multiple modules raises a RuntimeError
test_stl_bind_local: test STL containers like LocalVec and LocalMap with module-local bindings across modules
test_cross_module_calls: test cross-module function calls including return_self, return_copy, and inheritance casting with Cat and Dog
